title: A memories call refused for its context generation offers the memories retry, not an advancing next
outcome: A memories call refused for its context generation offers the memories retry, not an advancing next
acceptance: When `engram work memories` (any form: listing, search, full or history read) is refused because its context generation is not a plain token, the CLI text, the CLI JSON error and the MCP error offer `engram work memories` as the retry command and not `engram work next`; a refused `next` still offers `engram work next`; tests assert the retry command on the CLI and MCP routes for both words.

completion.summary: A memories call refused for its context generation now offers the memories retry (engram work memories …) instead of an advancing next, on MCP, CLI JSON and CLI text; unit and dogfood tests cover it. Landed in 99c249e (bundle 8C-1).
